summary: Over the weekend of April 18-19, 2026 the "Press Lounge" section of the Seiko USA website was defaced with a page titled "HACKED" claiming the attackers had breached the company's Shopify backend and downloaded its entire customer database (names, emails, phone numbers, order history, shipping addresses and account details), and threatening to publish it unless Seiko USA negotiated.
